findings.current: As I leaned against the spear in a pitiful state, I found myself regretting the Dance of the Fire God and Demon, which Jeok Cheongang still hadn’t taught me.
findings.defect: “Regretting the Dance” suggests that Taekyung regrets the technique itself, whereas he wishes Jeok Cheongang had taught it to him.
findings.rationale: The source expresses disappointment that the technique remains unavailable to him, not regret about the technique.
findings.replacement: As I leaned pitifully against the spear for support, I couldn’t help wishing Jeok Cheongang had taught me the Dance of the Fire God and Demon.
findings.source: 애처로운 모습으로 창에 몸을 지탱하고 있으려니 아직 적천강이 가르쳐 주지 않은 화신귀무(火神鬼舞)가 아쉽게 느껴졌다.

findings.current: To be honest, at this point, I felt like I might die an early death while using One Annihilation before I ever got the chance to use it.
findings.defect: “Die an early death” changes 객사, which means dying away from home, and weakens the deliberate repetition with the following sentence.
findings.rationale: The source specifically invokes death away from home, then repeats that idea in the next sentence for comic emphasis.
findings.replacement: To be honest, at this rate, I felt like I might die far from home using One Annihilation before then.
findings.source: 솔직히 이쯤 되면 그전에 일섬 쓰다가 객사할 것 같기도 했다.

findings.current: An elderly man with a massive build and a spider so huge that “large” hardly seemed sufficient as a description landed on the ground, using the Thousand-Year Spider as a cushion while it convulsed with barely any life left in it.
findings.defect: The compound subject makes both the old man and the spider perform the landing and use the spider as a cushion. The source says only the Beast Miao King lands, with the barely living spider beneath him.
findings.rationale: The Beast Miao King is the actor who descends and lands; the Thousand-Year Spider is the cushion.
findings.replacement: The heavily built old man landed on the ground using the Thousand-Year Spider—so enormous that “huge” suited it better than “large”—as a cushion while it convulsed with barely any life left in it.
findings.source:
육중한 체구의 노인과 크다는 말보다는 거대하다는 표현이 더 어울릴 법한 거미.

숨만 붙은 채 경련하는 천년지주를 쿠션 삼아 지면에 내려앉은 야수묘왕이 붉게 상기된 얼굴로 내게 두 팔을 벌렸다.

findings.current: The Beast Miao King’s flushed face brightened as he spread both arms toward me.
findings.defect: “Brightened” adds a change in expression absent from the source; his face is simply flushed red.
findings.rationale: The source describes his coloration and movement without saying that his expression brightens.
findings.replacement: His face flushed red, the Beast Miao King spread both arms toward me.
findings.source: 숨만 붙은 채 경련하는 천년지주를 쿠션 삼아 지면에 내려앉은 야수묘왕이 붉게 상기된 얼굴로 내게 두 팔을 벌렸다.

findings.current: But one thing was certain: unmistakable emotion was spreading across the Beast Miao King’s face.
findings.defect: “Emotion” is too vague for 감동, which specifically indicates that he is visibly moved.
findings.rationale: The source identifies his emotional response as being touched or moved, which matters to Taekyung’s successful appeal.
findings.replacement: But one thing was certain: the Beast Miao King couldn’t hide how moved he was.
findings.source: 하지만 한 가지 확실한 것은, 지금 야수묘왕의 얼굴 위로 숨길 수 없는 감동이 번지고 있다는 것이었다.

findings.current: Before I could continue thinking, the Beast Miao King’s thick palm, which had been following behind me while keeping watch over our sides and rear, touched my shoulder.
findings.defect: The relative clause grammatically makes the Beast Miao King’s palm follow behind and keep watch. The Beast Miao King is the one following and guarding their flanks and rear.
findings.rationale: The source assigns the vigilance and movement to the Beast Miao King, then has him place his palm on Taekyung’s shoulder.
findings.replacement: Before I could continue thinking, the Beast Miao King, who had been following behind while keeping watch over our flanks and rear, placed his thick palm on my shoulder.
findings.source: 그리고 계속해서 생각을 이어 가기도 전에, 측면과 후방을 경계하며 뒤따라오던 야수묘왕의 두꺼운 손바닥이 내 어깨를 짚었다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it contains two subject/action ambiguities and several localized meaning or characterization shifts.
